user.title: iCloud Shared Photos
user.description: Exposes the iCloud Shared Photo Library and favorites in the media browser. No credentials are needed: the authenticated session of the Apple iCloud integration is reused.

abort.icloud_not_configured: Set up the Apple iCloud integration first. This integration reuses its authenticated session.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

data_description.max_items: Limits how many items are listed per album. Large libraries are paged from iCloud until this limit is reached.
data_description.include_videos: Also list videos (Live Photos are always served as still images).
data_description.image_version: Automatic serves the original for JPEG/PNG and Apple's JPEG derivative for HEIC and RAW.
data_description.cache_ttl: How long album listings are kept in memory. Photos themselves are never stored.

get_album_photos.name: Get shared album photos
get_album_photos.description: Lists the photos of an iCloud Shared Album with signed, time-limited URLs (HEIC is delivered as JPEG). Use the response to push photos to a display, e.g. a BLOOMIN8 frame.

album.name: Album
album.description: Name (or id) of the Shared Album.

account.name: Account
account.description: Apple ID (title of the iCloud integration entry). Defaults to all accounts.

expires.name: URL lifetime
expires.description: How long the returned URLs stay valid.
